description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and structures for inter-process communication (IPC) within the WPEFramework core module. It includes message serialization/deserialization, IPC channel management, and factory mechanisms for handling IPC messages and responses.

classes.name: IMessage
classes.description: Interface for messages that can be serialized and deserialized for IPC communication.

classes.name: IIPC
classes.description: Interface representing an IPC message with label, parameters, and response.

classes.name: IIPCServer
classes.description: Interface for IPC server handlers that process incoming IPC messages.

classes.name: IPCMessageType
classes.description: Template class defining specific IPC message types with parameters and responses.

classes.name: IPCChannel
classes.description: Abstract class managing IPC channels, registration, invocation, and response reporting.

classes.name: IPCChannelType
classes.description: Template class extending IPCChannel, implementing specific link and extension mechanisms for IPC communication.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an IMessage object into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into an IMessage object.

methods.name: ReportResponse
methods.description: Reports an IPC response back through the channel.
